audience: marketers and operations teams using MillionVerifier for email verification

useCases.title: Check available verification credits
useCases.text: Read the remaining MillionVerifier credit balance before starting an individual check or bulk upload.

useCases.title: Screen a new email address
useCases.text: Confirm credit usage to verify one email and review its result. Unknown and catch-all outcomes do not establish that a mailbox is deliverable.

useCases.title: Submit a list for bulk verification
useCases.text: Confirm credit usage to upload a CSV of 1–1,000 addresses. Keep the returned file ID, then check its progress and aggregate verification counts, waiting between checks.

useCases.title: Review an existing bulk job
useCases.text: Use a known file ID to inspect progress, aggregate result counts and failed or canceled status. Read individual email results in the MillionVerifier dashboard.
